justification: Although the case concerns peaceful assembly complaints under Article 11, the Court does not conduct a standalone Article 11 merits analysis but instead disposes of the Article 11 complaints by a bare cross-reference to well-established case-law (Frumkin and Tsvetkova), without any independent reasoning, and the operative provisions do not identify a specific Article 11 violation by article number in the holding, making this a formulaic repetitive-case disposal rather than a genuine merits adjudication.
